Cloud platform for coding agents
Ellipsis is a cloud platform that allows engineering teams to deploy fleets of coding agents. Each agent gets an isolated sandbox, scoped permissions, and hard budget caps. Full observability included. Get started with a $100 credit at www.ellipsis.dev. You can deploy agents for feature development, code review, and workflow automation.
Creating an agent is simple: simply commit a YAML file to Github. Spawn agents from Github/Linear/Slack/etc., or via a REST API or our CLI. Organizations get full observability and governance of their cloud coding agents. Agent session logs are downloadable so companies own their own data. Full documentation: https://www.ellipsis.dev/docs
I've worked as an ML Engineer at AWS and Amazon Ads, in addition to filling various engineering roles at companies like Brigit and Capital One. Before that, I published in the field of Astrophysics.

Why we built Ellipsis
Code review. Production debugging. Standup reports. The 47 stale PRs nobody's looking at. We started Ellipsis because we were tired of doing all of it ourselves.
Read our blog View us on Y Combinator
Our mission
Every engineering team has more work than people. AI agents should handle the repetitive, time-consuming work so your engineers can focus on what actually needs a human. We're not building AGI. We're building the control plane that lets teams put agents to work safely.
How we got here
Ellipsis started in 2023 when we saw that AI could do more than autocomplete: it could review, reason, and ship. We went through Y Combinator (W24), launched with automated code review, and quickly expanded into a full platform of AI agents connected to the tools teams already use.
Today, Ellipsis is installed on 67,000+ repositories across 400+ companies.
